from_speaker: pause new signups for the student and paid individual tiers
actual cost of their token burn
our_interpretation: Assess whether Microsoft held the three stated policy plans on April 20, 2026, rather than treating eventual implementation as a forecast with an invented deadline.
Paid individual tiers means Pro and Pro+, as specified in the surrounding text.

Read token-based billing as charging according to token consumption and model prices. The surrounding API-price example indicates retail token charges, not verified reimbursement of Microsoft's internal costs.
Later statements count as evidence of April intent only when they explicitly describe the earlier restrictions as preparation for the billing transition.
The assessment addresses the substance of the plans, not independent authentication of the leaked documents.
criteria.support_condition: Dated company statements or reliable reporting of those statements establish the signup pause, tighter usage limits, and an already-planned transition to token-based billing.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable contemporaneous records establish that a material stated plan did not exist, was misreported, or concerned different subscription tiers.
